home.description: I'm a Software Engineering Co-op student at Concordia with internship experience at Genetec and Intact. At Genetec, I worked on a company-wide design system, and at Intact, I worked as a DevOps Developer building CI/CD pipelines. I also won PolyHacks 2025 for creating an AI-powered app promoting sustainable fishing. I'm always eager to learn and explore new technologies.

cegep.title: CÉGEP Graduation
cegep.description: Completed a DEC in Natural Sciences at Bois-de-Boulogne College.

university.title: Started University
university.description: Began a Bachelor's in Software Engineering at Concordia University in the Co-op program.

internship1.title: First Software Development Internship
internship1.description: Interned at Genetec, contributing to a multi-platform design system using StencilJS, TypeScript, and Storybook for reusable web components.

internship2.title: Second Software Development Internship
internship2.description: Interned at Intact as a DevOps Developer, building CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and developing Node.js automation tools for production releases.

hackathon.title: First Hackathon – McHacks
hackathon.description: Built CasperAI, an AI-powered CASPer test prep tool using React, Node.js, and the OpenAI API during McHacks 2025.

hackathonWin.title: First Hackathon Win – PolyHacks
hackathonWin.description: Won 1st place at PolyHacks 2025 with AquaScan, a React Native app that identifies fish species and checks Quebec fishing regulations using AI.

next.title: What's Next?
next.description: Currently seeking my third internship opportunity to continue growing as a software developer.

paperTrading.title: MERN Full Stack Paper Trading Platform
paperTrading.description: Co-developed a paper trading platform simulating U.S. equities trading with real-time market data.

petAdoption.title: Full Stack Pet Adoption Service
petAdoption.description: Created a web application for a pet adoption service, allowing users to register and manage pet listings.

marketForecaster.title: Machine Learning Market Forecaster
marketForecaster.description: Developed a tool predicting Bitcoin and S&P 500 prices using machine learning models based on historical data.

othelloGame.title: Java Othello Game
othelloGame.description: Built a fully functional Othello game in Java, implementing core mechanics and object-oriented design.

peerReview.title: Full Stack Peer Review Service
peerReview.description: Led a team to build a full-stack app for peer and professor reviews. Integrated state management, Agile practices, and CI with Mocha/Chai tests.

fishingAssistant.title: AI-Powered Fishing Assistant (PolyHacks 2025 Winner)
fishingAssistant.description: Built a React Native app to identify fish species and verify Quebec fishing laws using AI and web scraping. Won 1st place at PolyHacks 2025.

casperAI.title: CasperAI (McHacks 2025)
casperAI.description: Created an AI-powered practice tool for the CASPer test using OpenAI API. Delivered actionable feedback on empathy, ethics, and decision-making.
